stories.title: Police and Natural Resources Wales carry out joint patrol against illegal off-roading in Halkyn
stories.summary: Police and Natural Resources Wales carried out a joint patrol in the Halkyn area this week, targeting illegal off-roading on protected wildlife land. The patrol focused on Sites of Special Scientific Interest, land protected for its wildlife or geology, which have seen repeated illegal off-roading. stories.title: Wales’ PISA scores lowest in UK for third assessment running
stories.summary: Wales recorded the lowest scores of all four UK nations in reading, science and maths in the latest PISA international education rankings, published today. stories.title: New pizza restaurant opens in Shotton with free pizza giveaway
stories.summary: A new pizza restaurant is opening in Shotton this week. Caprinos Pizza will open its fourth Welsh store at 73 Chester Road West on Wednesday, September 9. stories.title: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10, with Mind Cymru urging people to talk openly
stories.summary: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10. This year’s theme is changing the narrative on suicide, with the aim of encouraging people to talk about suicide and suicidal behaviour more openly. Mind Cymru says talking about mental health can still feel scary or shameful for many people, and wants to help reduce that stigma.
